renderer.note: Vendored directly rather than as a submodule. Only the Rust crates, the C++ scene engine and their build files remain here.

sceneEngine.note: Property-script updates continue from the current dynamic value rather than restarting from the authored base each frame, preserving hover interpolation and explicit property writes. Script input serialization copies no live subscriptions. Synthetic regressions cover convergence, interrupted reversal and user-value replacement. Scene parsing, the scene runtime and the offscreen probes carry local fixes. Latest on 2026-09-16: property scripts bound to a layer's visible/origin/scale/angles settings are no longer dropped when the authored visible value is falsy; alignment anchors for image layers are owned by SceneRuntimeContext, and RegisterNode no longer re-seeds a registered anchor from the already-offset node translate, so a dynamic origin or scale can neither lose the anchor nor double-count it; offscreen_scene_probe requests the production device extensions and dumps node transforms. Also 2026-09-16: WPPuppetLayer copies share one playback state that SceneScript reaches as IAnimationLayer through SceneRuntimeContext::PuppetAnimationControl, with animationlayers visible/rate/blend bound to user properties; cursor hit tests run in layer-local space and consult a parse-time alpha coverage mask for cursor-scripted image layers; offscreen_scene_probe gains WE_TEST_CLICK_OFFSET. Also 2026-09-16: cursor input is mapped through the presented scaling viewport and global camera instead of the raw canvas, and named layers only receive cursor events inside the drawn content rectangle, so hit testing matches where cropped or letterboxed wallpapers actually draw; synthetic regressions cover the cropped-presentation hit test and letterbox rejection.

applicationShell.note: Relocated out of upstream/renderer/app on 2026-09-16 so the application sources this project actively develops are not mixed into vendored third-party code. The relocation moves files only: the GPL-2.0-only terms and upstream copyright notices continue to apply. upstream/renderer/app/InfoPlist.xcstrings moved to App/Resources/InfoPlist.xcstrings and is excluded from the build in project.yml. Upstream's own app/WallpaperEngine.xcodeproj was removed because project.yml plus xcodegen generate the Xcode project for this repository; restore it from the revision above if an upstream comparison needs it.
